verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is an AML and KYC compliance platform, and products of that kind can plausibly include identity verification that handles biometric data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers sanctions and PEP screening, case management, exports, audit trails and webhooks. Nothing in it documents biometric data handling, GDPR lawful bases for biometrics, BIPA or other US biometric statutes, or consent language.
